headline: GoPro says it's still committed 'to your collective stoke'
summary: GoPro CEO assures customers the company's "core DNA" remains camera making. This follows a proposed $285 million acquisition by Starman. The merger aims to strengthen GoPro's content creation tech development.

headline: Roland is getting into generative AI music with Melody Flip
summary: Roland launches Melody Flip, its new generative AI music tool. Available as a DAW plug-in, it offers 250 themed "Palettes." The tool helps users generate musical ideas based on genre.

headline: AGI is whatever you want it to be
summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Astra and declared "the AGI era" is here. The Vergecast discusses the implications of this supposed AGI era. Panelists also analyze Nvidia's recent acquisition.

headline: Microsoft says virtually nobody was grabbing NYT articles through its chatbot
summary: Microsoft claims its Copilot rarely reproduces full sentences from news articles. This is part of its defense against copyright claims from publishers like NYT. Microsoft provided 8.2 million Copilot interactions as evidence in the lawsuit.

headline: GTA 6 for Xbox: You Can Save $10, Today Only
summary: Xbox owners can get a $10 discount on Grand Theft Auto 6's ultimate edition. This special offer is available for today only. Use a simple workaround to access the limited-time deal.

headline: New Resident Evil Teaser Trailer Reveals First Glimpse at Creature That Looks a Lot Like Las Plagas
summary: A new Resident Evil movie trailer reveals a tentacle-like mutation. The creature bears a striking resemblance to Las Plagas from RE4. The Spanish-language teaser includes never-before-seen footage.

headline: Mrs. Doubtfire Is Releasing on 4K This September – Here’s Where to Preorder It
summary: The beloved comedy "Mrs. Doubtfire" is getting a 4K release. The 4K version is set to release on September 29. Preorder details and bonus features are now available.

headline: DLSS 5 Will Be Coming to Older Graphics Cards After All
summary: Nvidia confirms DLSS 5 support will extend to RTX 40 series graphics cards. An Nvidia employee announced the expansion on the company's forums. Users should expect a waiting period before the update arrives.

headline: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
summary: Violence has escalated in Middlesbrough following a fatal A66 crash. Residents express deep distrust and fear of the police. BBC News reports on the town living in a state of alarm.

headline: Farage threatens to overhaul Lords and judges to meet his pledges
summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage vows to reform the House of Lords and judiciary. He promises to deliver key priorities within his first 100 days in power. These changes depend on his party winning the government.

headline: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
summary: The UN approved a resolution for a new world map reflecting Africa's actual size. The Togo-sponsored resolution garnered support from 164 nations. The United States was the sole nation to vote against the adoption.

headline: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
summary: Nepal experiences a "rare moment of joy" with recent tunnel rescues. These rescues offer hope for hundreds still trapped in flood-affected tunnels. Workers remain stuck in a network of tunnels along the Trishuli river.
